title: Titration Calculation - Strong Acid and Strong Base
body: 25 cm^3 of hydrochloric acid (HCl) is titrated against 0.1 mol/dm^3 sodium hydroxide (NaOH). It requires 20 cm^3 of NaOH for complete neutralization. The balanced equation is: HCl + NaOH -> NaCl + H2O. Calculate the concentration of the hydrochloric acid.
oer: Siyavula Grade 12 Physical Sciences - Acids and Bases
